One such circumstance is lunar intensity, which Vadamalai Elangovan and Ganapathi Marimuthu found to be negatively associated with foraging by greater short-nosed fruit bats but Deborah J. Curtis and colleagues found to be positively associated with foraging by mongoose lemurs. This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the lemurs' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the bats. 题目 67% - 0.93 0.19% Question 9 Information in the text best supports which statement about mongoose lemurs?
